title: Parking spot sharing
summary: Rent out your driveway or parking spot.
whyTempting: Parking is scarce and owners have idle spaces.
whyItFails: Local liquidity. Demand is hyper-local. Low prices. Spot owners earn little. Access issues. Gates and keys complicate things.
whatWouldChange: Smart access tech and integration with navigation apps.

attempts.outcome: Pulled out of San Francisco in 2014
attempts.notes: Let drivers auction public street spaces; the city attorney called it a predatory private market.
Let drivers sell the public street spot they were leaving.

reasons.detail: Low prices: Spot owners earn little.
Access issues: Gates and keys complicate things.
